all_item_rows.scope_or_gate: Under universal Tate and semisimplicity, comparison reduces to Chow-cycle injectivity in codimension m on varieties of dimension 2m−1, m≥2. The first case is codimension2 on threefolds; it is now proved for universal surface-supported zero-cycles, including geometrically uniruled threefolds. No Parshin or higher-codimension conclusion follows for an individual such variety. The rational blow-up test class retains arbitrary centres and is not counted as a further resolution. The new limit diagnostics refute two shortcuts involving continuous-cohomology colimits and completed Frobenius modules; they do not prove the required uniform ramification control. On the specified two-boundary open in P4, the comparison cokernel is exactly im(G) intersect ker(cl) on its threefold components. This fixed-open formula neither proves vanishing nor proves survival under further shrinking. The ordinary Milnor regulator has exactly the infinitely ell-divisible kernel in every degree; the residue criterion holds in positive degree. This uses the diagonal twist and does not remove the weight-zero part of the degree-three/twist-two residue gate. The separated ordinary Milnor quotient is countably free and has the same completion. A fully explicit free submodule of a sum of finite permutation lattices nevertheless acquires eigenvalue4 after3-adic completion, so freeness does not control the missing completed eigenclasses. The separated quotient is in fact canonical and common to every coefficient prime different from p: divisibility maps trivially into any of the proved free quotients. The same formal integral module can nevertheless have a completed eigenvalue at3 and none at any other prime, so the common quotient does not resolve the required comparison.
